One of the '''throne rooms''' of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served as the public seat of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] from the foundation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In addition, it was in this throne room that [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was nearly killed in an [[Ghost Prison incident|attempted coup]] by [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]].

==History==
During the [[Ghost Prison incident|Gentis Coup]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was nearly killed by [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]]' military coup against the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] via [[Aorth-6]] at his throne room, which he only survived due to his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|connection]] to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Ghost Prison 2" />

In large part because of the attempted coup, the finalization of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] was hastened.<ref name="FC1">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 1|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 1]]</ref>

==Layout==
The layout of the throne greatly resembled that of the later [[Imperial Throne Room|Imperial Palace throne room]], which was completed alongside the Imperial Palace itself circa [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
It was initially assumed to be located in the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]], although Randy Stradley confirmed that it was indeed intended to be the Imperial Palace.
